general.description: Aan'Tsch' is a small and frozen world, as small as a moon. In Shaads History, it was one of the main base for Interstellar exploration, and it's still what it is now, expecially with the construction of Aii'el, a new slingstation in its orbit. The planet house some scientific and spacefaring base-domes on its ground.
general.bar: Scientists and engineers, mainly Sshaads, taking a break, with a few glasses of Gl'tsh and pecking some rocknuts, chatting about the latests gossips.
